B033-01.notes: Opposite angles of cyclic quad supplementary: 5x+30=180, x=30, A=100. Distractor 30 = x, 80 = C.

B033-04.notes: 1/b = 1/c - 1/a = (a-c)/(ac), b = ac/(a-c). B is sign-error trap, C is unreciprocated.

B033-05.notes: T(n)=3n+1=100 -> n=33. 34 is off-by-one trap (100/3 rounded).

B033-06.notes: Glue Ana-Ben as block: 5 units around circle (5-1)!=24, times 2 internal orders = 48. Circular permutations are unfamiliar to most ACT takers; 24 and 240 are strong traps.

B033-08.notes: 53, 59, 61, 67 -> 4. Endpoints 50,70 not prime so inclusive/exclusive ambiguity is moot.

flags: minor: equal times make the simple average correct, so the 48 (harmonic-mean) distractor only catches over-thinkers; item is essentially one step
